_about: One line per chapter for each switch position, in our own words, shown (and played, once generated) when a chapter starts or the switch is flipped. Chapter 7 in RELEASED mode has its own milestone narration (evolution.json), so it has no line here. The rule: never claim randomness alone creates anything; structure needs randomness plus a flow of energy.

hot.controlled: A perfectly even beginning: no ripples at all. The first light is one smooth glow.
hot.released: The first light carries tiny random ripples: the seeds of everything that follows.

web.controlled: A perfectly even universe. Gravity pulls the same way everywhere, so nothing gathers. No stars.
web.released: Tiny random ripples. Gravity finds them, deepens them, and the first stars ignite.

galaxy.controlled: With nothing clumped, there is nothing to become a galaxy. Just an even haze.
galaxy.released: Stars and gas settle into a spinning disk: our galaxy takes shape.

solar.controlled: No stars, so no Sun and no planets.
solar.released: Around the young Sun, rocks collide and stick together until a few planets remain.

earth.controlled: No Solar System, so no Earth.
earth.released: The young Earth cools, and oceans form under an orange sky.

life.controlled: Everything in its place, no randomness. Energy flows in, but nothing new can form.
life.released: Let the particles wander and keep the energy flowing, and structures build themselves.

evolution.controlled: Every creature identical, no mutations. Generation after generation, nothing changes.

humans.controlled: No humans in a controlled universe.
humans.released: And here we are: one species, spreading across the planet.
